test_CheckpointHook_constructors: test the CheckpointHook constructor with valid and invalid config including checkpoint_folder and checkpoint_period
test_CheckpointHook_on_phase_end: test the CheckpointHook on_phase_end method to verify checkpoint saving raises exceptions on failure
test_CheckpointHook_state_checkpointing: test the CheckpointHook state checkpointing to verify checkpoints are saved only on the correct phase_type
test_CheckpointHook_checkpoint_period: test the CheckpointHook checkpoint_period parameter to verify checkpoints are saved only after the specified number of phases
test_load_checkpoint_and_resume: test loading a saved checkpoint with load_checkpoint and resuming training with LocalTrainer on GPU or CPU
